{{Quote|Borgles are more than mean. It's like they're evil right down to their core. Maybe because of all the time they spend in their caves, in the dark.|[[Fingers]]|<ref name="TRoD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>}}
The '''Borgle Bat Cave''' was a deep cavern system in the swamp lands of the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was home to a high number of dangerous [[borgle bat]]s.<ref name="SWG:BBC" />

==History==
{{Quote|You must help me! My husband was telling our kids about the caves filled with Borgles, and it seems they went off to go see the caves firsthand. I'm afraid the worst has happened to them!|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Rori}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the animal herder [[Fingers]] hunted borgle bat to their cave on Rori in order to capture some specimens for arena pit-fighting competition. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Dusque Mistflier]] and [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineer]] [[Tendau Nandon]] explored the cave to study its Borgle bat population.<ref name="TRoD" />
